name: Product Shot Studio
intro: Product Shot Studio turns one product photo into a studio-quality image in a scene you choose, and can also make a short ad video.

features.mode-toggle-product-shot-ad-video: The mode toggle at the top switches between Product shot for still images and Ad video for a short promo clip.
features.model-product-shot-product-photography: The Model dropdown offers Product Shot for fast catalog images, and Product Photography when you want a lighting-focused result.
features.product-media-upload: Product Media is where you add your product. Upload an image, or browse stock photos from Pexels to test. The product is the star of every result.
features.scene-preset: Scene Preset gives you nine one-click backdrops, from studio white to luxury marble or a cozy wooden table. Pick one to set the mood.
features.output-format: Output Format matches the shape to where you'll use the image, with choices for an ad banner, a social post, a story or a billboard.
features.ad-video-script-and-image-references: In Ad video mode, write a short script in the text box. Your product image is image one, and an optional avatar is image two.
features.ad-video-avatar-and-references: Add an optional avatar or pick one from the presets, plus extra reference images, to give your ad a presenter and style.
features.ad-video-format-ratio-resolution-duratio: Ad video also lets you choose a format like UGC or Unboxing, an aspect ratio, a resolution and a duration for your clip.

outro: That's Product Shot Studio. Start with a plain, well-lit product photo, try a few scenes, and you've got catalog and ad visuals without a photo shoot.
